title: The future of onchain FX could start with users, not institutional liquidity
summary: Onchain FX does not need to recreate the trillion-dollar institutional market to become useful. Real demand can make smaller markets work first.

title: Here’s what happened in crypto today
summary: Need to know what happened in crypto today? Here is the latest news on daily trends and events impacting Bitcoin price, blockchain, DeFi, Web3 and crypto regulation.

title: Bitcoin briefly drops to $17K on Kraken, exchange upholds trades
summary: Kraken said all orders were processed correctly and found no evidence of a security breach or compromised accounts.

title: South Korean exchanges halt CYBER transfers amid suspected bridge exploit
summary: Cyber reported unexpected minting of CYBER tokens on Solana, followed by tokens moving out of its Ethereum bridge lockbox, prompting an investigation.

title: Chainflip confirms $12M hack, offers attacker 10% bounty
summary: Chainflip offered the attacker a 10% bounty to return 90% of the stolen funds by Nov. 23, promising to treat the return as a white-hat recovery and withdraw law enforcement complaints.

title: ECB seeks industry partners for tokenized deposits, securities experiments
summary: Industry groups have until Dec. 11 to apply for the ECB’s first experimental exercises under its Appia initiative, with later submissions reviewed on a rolling basis.

title: US lawmakers propose up to 30% rewards for prediction market whistleblowers
summary: Whistleblowers could receive 10% to 30% of monetary sanctions in qualifying prediction market fraud cases exceeding $1 million in penalties.

title: Hong Kong pushes to bring crypto custodians, advisers under licensing rules
summary: Hong Kong’s securities regulator says the proposal would strengthen investor protections, with the bill set for its first reading in the Legislative Council on Dec. 2.

title: Wrapped Monero token crashes 99.8% amid suspected $13.5M exploit
summary: Bitquery traced $13.5 million in suspicious sales of the wrapped Monero token, as its operator blamed a security breach and promised to reimburse affected traders.

title: Sky Protocol sees $2 billion in stablecoin withdrawals, disputes illicit fund claims
summary: Sky says its USDS stablecoin held its $1 value despite more than $2 billion in withdrawals, as it disputes a report linking the protocol to illicit activity.
